facts.raw_span: A patient in their 70s
medical history of type 2 diabetes and hypertension
presented to the emergency department with fatigue, light-headedness, and dyspnea on exertion during the previous week
heart rate of 47 beats per minute
blood pressure of 148/59 mm Hg
Normal sinus rhythm at 72 beats per minute
PR interval prolongs between first and second conducted beats

Surface ECG showed sinus rhythm
